subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When any assurance pass escalates because of a declined blocking finding, defective charter, or other judgment conflict, the reviewer shall record one decision brief on the proposal naming the conflict, options with risks, evidence, and decision needed; a pre-release brief authorizes no production acceptance, and after activation it shall hold PR-raise and route the proposal HUMAN through the required consuming merge-lane adapter.
rationale: escalation remains brief+park, while direct activation removes the old production advisory state
fit_criterion: each escalation class produces a schema-valid brief; pre-release fixtures cannot authorize production; post-activation end-to-end fixtures hold PR-raise and force HUMAN without granting AUTO
